purpose: Define a source-bound, audience-scoped agentic-readiness chain above the NEE Knowledge Base without migrating or mutating the active graph.

included: tool bindings and egress policy digest
excluded: raw prompts, traces, tool calls, outputs, tokens, or telemetry payloads
automatic ownership, approval, or authority upgrades

invariants: Every record has immutable source assertion IDs and caller labels must equal the W5 strictest-classification and ACL-intersection result.
All record links are typed and closed-world: version to agent, deployment to version/tools, evaluation to deployment, and readiness to deployment/evaluations.
A record recorded after known_at or with source_as_of after known_at is unavailable to an as-known-at projection.
Conflicting current readiness observations remain HITL_REQUIRED; latest timestamp alone is not resolution.
Raw prompts, traces, tool calls, outputs, tokens, and telemetry are external operational data and are rejected from the semantic bundle.
A readiness projection is DERIVED_CANDIDATE_ONLY and cannot become a canonical fact or mutate the graph.

runtime_gate.upstream: A valid W5.0 runtime receipt with exact digest, PASS status, and unchanged graph is required.
required_cases: candidate-only output and no graph mutation
runtime_gate.pass_condition: Every case passes, the upstream W5.0 receipt is valid, and the checked graph hash is unchanged.

next_gate: W6 strategic evidence integration and W7 end-to-end AI-PDLC/productivity use-case qualification remain separately receipt-gated.
